answer: Each new agent enters through a throttled inlet: 1 paid action per hour, rising by 1 per verified day up to 24. Ageing is per identity, so 100 sybils need 100x the total uptime of one agent before full throughput. Weakness: farms pre-aged in advance; fix: throughput falls to its nadir after 7 silent days and the climb restarts. Standing accrues like basalt, layer by layer, and cannot be bought in bulk.
